text:
amal: Heads up — Sat 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC: we're doing a fleet ramp + VLAN switchover in us-west1. Rolling reboots across 3 cohorts, ~3h window. Purpose: NIC microcode + routing table refresh to address intermittent packet drops under heavy GPU load. Low-risk but will reduce headroom. Details below.

carmen: What's the expected capacity hit and customer impact?

amal: Rough estimate: 7–10% reduced GPU headroom during the full window; single cohort at a time ~3–4% of hosted pool. No planned customer outage, but heavy batched jobs might see p99 latency blips. We'll backfill critical traffic from eu-west spare capacity for affected routes.

lee: Can we pre-warm prefix/KV cache and bump autoscale thresholds to avoid cascading queue growth? Suggest pre-allocating a 20% burst 30m before start.

amal: Agreed. Plan: pre-warm KV cache, increase autoscale upper-bound to +25% for 45m, canary cohort of 5 racks, validate p90/p99 for 30m before continuing. Runbook has rollout YAML.

lee: ```sh
# cordon canary nodes
kubectl label nodes -l rack=canary maintenance=scheduled
kubectl cordon <node-name>
# ensure backfill pods land in eu-west1 pool
apply -f routing-backfill.yaml
```

riley: I'll draft customer-facing comms for status page and console banner. Do we want a short note or a targeted email for prioritized customers?

ops-oncall: I'll create #maint-uswest1 and add current oncall rotation. Also scheduling the maintenance in PagerDuty and calendar.

oncall-bot: scheduled-maint created: https://cal.internal/7754321111 — runbook: https://runbooks.internal/fleet/vlan-switchover (published)

carmen: :eyes: Cost note — cross-region backfill + temporary double allocation will add egress and instance costs. Ballpark +$1.5k for the 3h window. Approve?

amal: We have a $2k ops buffer this month for planned windows. Proceed.

riley: :thumbsup: I'll post the status page wording and ping solutions for customers we should notify directly.

lee: One more: add a routing-policy fallback to a lower-latency model-variant for latency-sensitive tenants during cohort 2. I'll open a tiny PR and tag @amal.

amal: Thanks all — timeline and preflight checklist are pinned in the runbook. If we see p99 > 1.5s or error rates spike, escalate immediately to #eng-oncall. :rotating_light:
